name: @openbindings/delegate-manager-consumer-qualification
description: Independent TypeScript consumer for the Delegate Manager: discovers the candidate's bound CLI OBI and served OBI and invokes the five shared operations through @openbindings/invoke over the published Usage and OpenAPI bindings. Installs the SDK packages from exact packed tarballs (see ../../../scripts/verify-delegate-consumers.mjs); no OB source, no manager-specific SDK class.
